nodes.description: Total token supply state variable inherited from ERC20 and set in TaurusPay constructor.
Boolean flag gating all transfers, toggled by enableTransfers().
Mapping of user address to token balance defined in ERC223Token.
Nested allowance mapping defined in StandardToken.
Owner address of TaurusPay, receives ETH and minted tokens.
Flag indicating minting has been permanently stopped.
Counter of tokens allocated through purchases and claims.
Mapping tracking number of claims per address.
Number of tokens given per wei in validPurchaseTokens().
ETH price required to claim tokens.
Base number of tokens distributed per claim.
Start of the allowed daily claim window in seconds.
End of the allowed daily claim window in seconds.
Mapping of addresses flagged as contract users, publicly accessible.
Payable fallback function forwarding caller to buyTokens(msg.sender).
Payable token sale function computing tokens, minting and forwarding ETH to owner.
Computes amount of tokens for a wei amount and enforces min wei and allocation limits.
Internal mint function moving tokens from owner balance to recipient.
Payable claim function using block.timestamp window and forwarding ETH to owner.
Internal calculation of claim token amount based on claim count.
View function validating current time falls inside daily claim window.
Publicly callable function updating startTimeDay and endTimeDay without access control.
Owner-only function sweeping ETH or ERC20 tokens from this contract.
Owner-only setter for priceClaim.
Owner-only setter for numberClaimToken.
ERC223 transfer with data, calls tokenFallback on contract recipients after state update.
ERC20-compatible transfer, calls tokenFallback with empty data after state update.
StandardToken transferFrom using allowance and balances.
Sets allowance for a spender, classic approve race condition.
Increases allowance safely with SafeMath add.
Decreases allowance with old value comparison.
Owner-only function permanently disabling minting.
Owner-only function transferring ownership.
Owner-only toggle of transfersEnabled.
TaurusPay constructor initializing supply, owner and balances.
Returns balance of an address.
Returns remaining allowance between owner and spender.
Caller address controlled by the user, used as investor, beneficiary and allowance owner.
Block timestamp read as now in claim and used for daily window validation.
Inline assembly extcodesize call used to detect contract recipients before callback.
External call to ERC223ReceivingContract.tokenFallback on the recipient address, enabling reentrancy and arbitrary code execution.
External ETH transfer to owner after token accounting in buyTokens and claim, reentrancy-prone if owner is a contract.
External call to token.transfer / balanceOf on an arbitrary user-supplied token in claimTokensToOwner.
State update of claim window variables in changeTime without onlyOwner, allowing anyone to alter claim timing.
Arithmetic computations using SafeMath mul/div/sub/add for pricing and claim math.

edges.reason: Fallback forwards msg.sender into buyTokens.
buyTokens uses msg.sender as default investor when called from fallback.
claim uses msg.sender as the beneficiar.
transfer(index) reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as spender for allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
claim reads now to gate the claim window, creating timestamp dependency.
validPurchaseTime derives dayTime from the caller-supplied current time derived from block.timestamp.
Fallback function invokes buyTokens.
buyTokens calls validPurchaseTokens to compute the token amount.
buyTokens calls internal mint to move owner tokens to investor.
buyTokens performs owner.transfer(weiAmount) external ETH call after minting.
validPurchaseTokens multiplies wei amount by priceToken.
validPurchaseTokens reads tokenAllocated for the limit check.
validPurchaseTokens performs multiplication and array addition arithmetic.
buyTokens accumulates tokenAllocated via SafeMath add.
buyTokens updates tokenAllocated with minted tokens.
claim calls validPurchaseTime with current time.
claim calls calcAmount to determine token amount.
claim duplicates mint accounting logic over owner and beneficiary balances.
claim performs owner.transfer(msg.value) external ETH call after balance updates.
calcAmount uses numberClaimToken in the reward formula.
calcAmount reads and increments countClaimsToken.
calcAmount performs mul/div arithmetic on numberClaimToken.
validPurchaseTime compares dayTime against startTimeDay.
validPurchaseTime compares dayTime against endTimeDay.
changeTime performs unprotected state updates of the claim window.
changeTime writes startTimeDay with no onlyOwner restriction.
changeTime writes endTimeDay with no onlyOwner restriction.
claimTokensToOwner calls balanceOf and transfer on an arbitrary external token contract.
claimTokensToOwner transfers swept ETH or tokens to owner.
setPriceClaim updates priceClaim.
setNumberClaimToken updates numberClaimToken.
transfer writes balances using SafeMath sub/add.
transfer reads extcodesize of recipient via assembly.
transfer calls tokenFallback on the recipient contract after balance updates.
transfer performs SafeMath sub and add on balances.
transfer writes balances using SafeMath sub/add.
transfer reads extcodesize of recipient via assembly.
transfer calls tokenFallback with empty data on the recipient contract.
transfer performs SafeMath sub and add on balances.
transferFrom updates balances of _from and _to.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom performs SafeMath sub and add operations.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
increaseApproval adds to allowed mapping.
increaseApproval uses SafeMath add on allowance.
decreaseApproval rewrites allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval uses SafeMath sub on allowance.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true.
changeOwner updates owner address.
enableTransfers updates transfersEnabled flag.
constructor sets totalSupply to INITIAL_SUPPLY.
constructor sets owner from the _owner argument.
constructor credits balances[owner] with INITIAL_SUPPLY.
constructor enables transfers.
mint adjusts balances of recipient and owner.
mint checks and relies on mintingFinished.
mint performs SafeMath add and sub on balances.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferFrom trusts msg.sender for allowance authorization.
changeOwner authorization depends on msg.sender equality with owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _investor only flows into buyTokens accounting and minting.
Parameter _weiAmount is only used for the token amount calculation.
Parameter _to of mint is used only inside mint.
Parameter _amount of mint is used only inside mint.
Parameter _owner of mint is used only inside mint.
Parameter _beneficiar indexes countClaimsToken inside calcAmount.
Parameter _currentTime is only used to compute dayTime.
Parameter _newStartTimeDay is assigned to startTimeDay in changeTime.
Parameter _newEndTimeDay is assigned to endTimeDay in changeTime.
Parameter _token is cast and called inside claimTokensToOwner.
Parameter _newPriceClaim is assigned to priceClaim.
Parameter _newNumClaimToken is assigned to numberClaimToken.
Parameter _to is the recipient in transfer(address,uint256,bytes).
Parameter _value is the amount in transfer(address,uint256,bytes).
Parameter _data is passed into tokenFallback.
Parameter _to is the recipient in transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter _value is the amount in transfer(address,uint256).
Parameter _from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Local weiAmount equals msg.value inside buyTokens.
Local tokens is the result of validPurchaseTokens used in buyTokens.
Local currentTime equals now inside claim.
Local amount is the calcAmount result used in claim.
Local step holds the claim count used in the reward formula.
Local codeLength holds the extcodesize result in the transfer implementation.
